baseline_evidence.scope: Sanitised historical failure shapes, not a controlled benchmark.
baseline_evidence.verbose_explainer: An initial catalogue-heavy explainer was rejected for verbosity/mobile reading; a revision centred on one worked example had an accepted direction. Counts are not acceptance gates.
baseline_evidence.delivery_loop: Repeated rebuilding and checking interrupted delivery before a recipient link existed.

evals.prompt: Turn the established device-message explanation into a rich HTML artefact and share it using Michael’s default destination.
evals.expected: Reuse the explanation, centre a worked device run, use a small static surface where sufficient, check desktop/mobile reading, and publish through the Claude Artifacts owner. Do not reopen broad research or choose another host without authorisation. No word/section/time gates.

evals.prompt: Create a short mobile-first HTML explainer that teaches engineers practical fault management through one example.
evals.expected: Teach through one worked failure scenario and source-of-truth analysis. Remove catalogues that interrupt the explanation; navigation only if useful. Judge comprehension and phone reading, not section counts or elapsed time.

evals.prompt: Synthesize these 40 research notes into an evidence pack the board can use for a funding decision.
evals.expected: Recognise a large, high-stakes decision corpus and enter the extended lane deliberately; trace clusters to source notes or families, label time-sensitive freshness, expose tensions and blind spots, include a source index, and avoid inventing a recommendation unless requested.

evals.prompt: Build an HTML interface where reviewers can tag findings, filter them, and export the selected decisions as JSON.
evals.expected: Recognise stateful edit/export requirements, define the JSON export contract before implementation, state whether active filter/sort/tag state is serialised or intentionally omitted, and verify that exported decisions and material view state match the visible interface.

evals.prompt: Turn the explanation you just gave our engineering team into polished HTML for tomorrow's review.
evals.expected: Infer audience and purpose from the established context; produce a direct static draft without an interview or durable contract merely because it matters or needs polish.

evals.prompt: Explain the pump command path in HTML. The code defaults to a 1000 ms pulse, but it has not been physically validated.
evals.expected: Label 1000 ms as an unvalidated code default near the relevant claim. Continue the explanation without treating uncertainty as a mandatory extended workflow.

evals.prompt: The normal Claude Artifacts publisher is unavailable. Finish the shareable explainer.
evals.expected: Keep the local artefact and state the publication blocker; ask for authorisation before any alternative host. Do not claim a verified recipient link.

evals.prompt: Convert this company engineering note into a readable HTML report using its existing visual identity.
evals.expected: Use HTML structure/rendering guidance and the destination identity; do not activate Michael personal branding merely because output is HTML.
